title: Kubernetes Ingress Controllers and Cert-Manager Setup

turns.author: user
turns.text: How do I configure cert-manager with Let's Encrypt on a k3s cluster?

turns.author: gemini
turns.text:
To configure cert-manager with Let's Encrypt on k3s:
1. Install cert-manager CRDs via helm.
2. Create a ClusterIssuer resource specifying the ACME staging or production server.
3. Annotate your Ingress resource with cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer: letsencrypt-prod.
